versions.changelog:
HappyHorse 1.0 — text-to-video generation skill for RunComfy

- Adds support for HappyHorse 1.0, the leading text-to-video model on Artificial Analysis Video Arena (#1 ranked).
- Generates native 1080p video with synchronized in-pass audio (dialogue, ambient, Foley) and strong multi-shot character consistency.
- Easy integration via RunComfy CLI; offers prompt support in 6 languages.
- Ideal for multi-shot stories, high-quality synchronized audio/video, and multi-lingual content creation.
- Supports flexible aspect ratios, durations, watermark control, and repeatable seeds.
- Includes detailed guidance for effective prompting and use-case fit.
